name: Coma Cluster, outskirts field 13 (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the outskirts of the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: comaoutskirts13-hubble
story: A patch of the Coma Cluster's outer infall region, one of the fields Hubble surveyed to find faint dwarf galaxies among the cluster's thousands of members.

claims.text: COMA-OUTSKIRTS-13 is one of the survey's outskirts positions
The Coma Cluster is also known as Abell 1656, one of the nearest rich galaxy clusters
The Hubble Coma survey imaged the core and infall region of Coma, focusing on dwarf galaxies among thousands of galaxies
